calls.reason: The Register documents one promising project hitting serious failures, followed by recovery and continued use. The small video study does not establish how often projects end badly.

The September study of 518 firsthand accounts documents recurring awareness of flawed code, production risks and corrective work. That supports emerging customer recognition, even without measuring its prevalence.

ObfusEval and CTF-Code show declines on altered tasks, but do not isolate familiarity. RealClassEval finds similar results on seen and unseen code; the evidence remains mixed and does not directly test amateur-built apps.
